value.rationale: A motivated all-size stationary bipartite NPT threshold in a standard single-excitation resource under local depolarization and ideal full-state restoration. The exponentially shrinking threshold and exact spectral-edge coefficient reveal collective high-dimensional noise geometry; this is a structural asymptotic and complete finite-n phase-order classification, not an arbitrary small-n table or a routine substitution. The limitation that negativity is exponentially weak is explicit.
